richiami.difetto: The oil/water separator in the engine breather may become blocked allowing the pressure to increase in the crankcase causing oil seals and the oil level sight glass to be displaced resulting in serious oil leaks.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the original crankcase breather hose and clips including the oil/water separator with a replacement hose and clips.

richiami.difetto: The handlebar retaining bolts may loosen or fail.  Which is extreme circumstances could result in loss of control of the machine.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the effected vehicles and replace the handlebar bolts with quality assured items.
richiami.titolo: HANDLEBAR RETAINING BOLTS MAY LOOSEN OR FAIL

richiami.difetto: The rear sprocket can work loose resulting in sprocket and chain jamming between the rear wheel and the swinging arm. This could result in the rear wheel skidding and possible loss of control.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will have the existing socket head screws replaced with longer hexagon bolts and secured in position with a lock ring.

richiami.difetto: The spokes in the rear wheel may work loose and consequently the wheel may fail without warning and cause an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Examine the potentially affected motorcycles and fit an upgraded rear wheel where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE WHEEL COLLAPSE DUE TO LOOSE/BROKEN SPOKES

richiami.difetto: The fuel pipe may perish and allow petrol to leak onto the engine. This could result in a fire.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a replacement fuel pipe where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: PETROL PIPE MAY PERISH AND LEAK.

richiami.difetto: The front brake flexible hose may rub on the tyre and subsequently leak. This could result in the sudden loss of front brake efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Examine the potentially affected motorcycles and fit a new front brake hose where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE HOSE MAY CHAFE ON THE TYRE.

richiami.difetto: The rear brake is not of an adequate standard and may not provide sufficient stopping power for emerency use with the possible result being an accident.
richiami.rimedio: The rework involves replacing the rear brake shoes brake cam and rerouting the brake cable.

richiami.difetto: The primary drive split gear may develop a fatigue crack. Under certain conditions this crack may cause a failure of the split gear without warning and cause the engine to stop suddenly.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected motorcycles and fit a replacement primary drive gear.

richiami.difetto: The primary drive split gear may develop a fatigue crack. Under certain conditions this crack may cause a failure of the split gear without warning and cause the engine to stop suddenly.
richiami.modello: V92 SPORT CRUISER , V92 SPORT CRUISER
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected motorcycles and fit a replacement primary drive gear.

richiami.difetto: The primary drive split gear may develop a fatigue crack. Under certain conditions this crack may cause a failure of the split gear without warning and cause the engine to stop suddenly.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected motorcycles and fit a replacement primary drive gear.

richiami.difetto: The threaded fasteners holding the front and rear brake discs to the wheels may fail without warning and adversely affect the brake performance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected motorcycles and fit quality assured replacement brake disc fasteners.

richiami.difetto: The threaded fasteners holding the front and rear brake discs to the wheels may fail without warning and adversely affect the brake performance.
richiami.modello: VICTORY V92C STANDARD , VICTORY V92C STANDARD
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected motorcycles and fit quality assured replacement brake disc fasteners.
